title: Venice International Film Festival
description: The 83rd Venice International Film Festival reaches its final day on 12 September, with public screenings on the Lido.
access: Public tickets
accessNote: Check the public screening programme for remaining sessions and admission; closing-ceremony access is not guaranteed.
notes: Already underway; only 12 September remains inside this preview's date window.

title: Ars Electronica · Negotiating Humanity
venue: OK Quarter, MED Campus, Danube Triangle and city venues
description: Linz's international media-art festival connects exhibitions, performances, technology and society. Its final weekend runs 12–13 September.
access: Public tickets
accessNote: Festival tickets are sold online and at festival information desks; check programme entries for individual access requirements.
notes: Already underway; 12–13 September remain inside this preview's date window.

title: Berlin Art Week
venue: Museums, galleries, collections and venues across Berlin
description: Contemporary art exhibitions, performances, screenings and talks across Berlin. The final weekend includes the Meet the Artist programme.
access: Mixed access
accessNote: Many events are free; partner venues set individual admission prices. Selected tours, performances and screenings require registration.
notes: Already underway; 12–13 September remain inside this preview's date window.

title: Venice Biennale · In Minor Keys
description: The 61st International Art Exhibition brings contemporary art and national pavilions across Venice. Already open; visit before the November closing.
access: Public tickets; check venue opening days before visiting.
scheduleNote: Giardini and Arsenale are closed Mondays, except 11 May, 1 June, 7 September and 16 November. Individual pavilions may have additional closures.

title: London Design Festival
venue: Design districts and venues across London
description: A citywide week of installations, exhibitions, open studios and design conversations. Explore the programme by neighbourhood and discipline.
access: Access and booking vary by individual event.

title: London Fashion Week · SS27
description: British fashion's spring/summer showcase. Runway events are mainly invitation only; the official schedule also identifies public showcases and pop-ups.
access: Industry access for most shows; selected events marked OPEN TO PUBLIC.

title: San Sebastián Film Festival
venue: Kursaal, Victoria Eugenia and city cinemas
description: The festival's 74th edition pairs international premieres, competitions and filmmaker appearances with a coastal Basque city break.
access: Screening tickets; check each session's access and language information.

title: Oktoberfest
description: Munich's enormous Bavarian folk festival: beer tents, brass bands, traditional food, parades and fairground rides.
access: Main grounds and tents have free admission; food, rides and some areas cost extra. Tent capacity is limited.

title: Milan Fashion Week · SS27
description: The womenswear spring/summer season across Milan. Treat this as an industry calendar; confirm individual event access before planning a visit.
access: Industry accreditation and individual invitations; public show admission is not guaranteed.

title: Vienna Design Week
venue: Festival headquarters and venues across Vienna
description: The festival's 20th edition explores objects, craft, experimental design and the city through exhibitions, workshops and open studios.
access: Check individual programme entries for opening hours and registration.

title: Paris Fashion Week · SS27
description: The womenswear spring/summer 2027 collections. Official shows and presentations require invitations from the fashion houses; FHCM does not sell tickets.
access: Invitation only for official shows and presentations.

title: BFI London Film Festival
venue: Royal Festival Hall, South Bank and West End cinemas
description: Public premieres, new films, screen talks and immersive storytelling across London. General ticket sales begin 17 September.
access: Public screening tickets; some free events bookable from 1 October.

title: Rome Film Fest
venue: Auditorium Parco della Musica and city venues
description: International cinema and premieres in Rome. The organiser expanded this year's edition to begin on 13 October.
access: Screening tickets and event-specific access; consult the final programme.

title: Frieze London & Frieze Masters
description: Two complementary fairs pair contemporary discovery with art history. Calendar shows ticketed public dates; 14 October is invitation only.
access: Public tickets from 1pm on 15 October; date/time-specific tickets purchased online.

title: Signal Festival
venue: Public spaces and gallery locations across Prague
description: Prague becomes a night-time exhibition of light, projection and immersive installations under the theme Dream On! Dreams and Visions.
access: Check the programme map for free locations and ticketed gallery installations.

title: Dutch Design Week
description: Nine days of experimental design, future-facing ideas and exhibitions across Eindhoven. The 2026 theme is R.A.W. — Rebel Authentic Worth.
access: DDW wristband required at participating paid locations; consult the programme.

title: Viennale
description: Vienna's international film festival brings a concentrated season of cinema to the city. Full programme: 13 October; ticket presale: 17 October.
access: Public screening tickets; presale starts 17 October at 10am local time.

title: Art Basel Paris
description: A major international art fair at the Grand Palais, with 211 exhibitors and a public programme connecting galleries and Parisian institutions.
access: Main public fair dates shown; earlier preview access has separate conditions.

title: Lucca Comics & Games
description: The 60th anniversary turns Lucca into a gathering for comics, games, illustration, cosplay and screen culture under the theme Legacy.
access: Day tickets and multi-day passes; selected talks may require separate reservations.

title: Web Summit
description: A large international technology gathering for founders, builders, investors and media, with talks, exhibitions and networking across four days.
access: Conference tickets; check pass inclusions and the official schedule.

title: IDFA Documentary Film Festival
description: Amsterdam's international documentary festival brings together films, new media, immersive work, conversations and filmmakers from around the world.
access: Consult the programme for public screenings and ticket releases.

title: Vienna Christmas Market
description: Vienna's Rathausplatz fills with festive stalls, seasonal food, lights and family attractions for the Christmas market season.
access: Market runs daily; separate conditions apply to skating and attractions.

title: Slush
venue: Messukeskus, Helsinki Expo and Convention Centre
description: A founder-focused startup and venture gathering with company-building talks, meetings and a dense programme of side events.
access: Category-specific conference passes; some side events require separate registration.

title: Nuremberg Christkindlesmarkt
description: One of Europe's best-known traditional Christmas markets, with handmade decorations, gingerbread and festive wooden stalls in the old town.
access: Opening ceremony 27 November at 5:30pm; reduced hours on Christmas Eve.

title: Fête des Lumières
description: Four evenings of light installations and projection transform Lyon's streets and landmarks into a large outdoor art experience.
access: Free public-space festival; consult the 2026 programme for routes and evening hours.
